title: Creole prejudice against darker musicians, and a job in a Creole hall
summary: Lewis describes Wooden Joe's looks and tells of a job where light-skinned Creoles treated him differently.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand
